name: compliance_training_completion_shortfall
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local compliance policy. A firm has headcount N={HEADCOUNT} employees, of whom C={COMPLETED} have completed mandatory AML training. Policy requires at least T={THRESHOLD} percent of headcount to have completed it. The required count is the smallest whole number of employees that is at least T percent of N. Use exact arithmetic. Report the current completion rate in percent and the required count, then compute how many additional completions are needed, floored at zero.

slots.description: Current training completion rate in percent.
